description.content: Logging configuration
Returns logs from the Ignition Gateway. Accepts query parameters in order to filter the result set.

query.description: Filters logs using the logger's MDC filtering properties. Must be provided in pairs as a list of strings.
Returned logs will be of level 'minLevel' and higher. One of [TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL, OFF]

Include results starting from this timestamp (Epoch millis).
Include results up to this timestamp (Epoch millis).

to specify the sort direction as ascending or descending, respectively.
A search string to filter items by. Terms separated by whitespace.

Filter items by field name, using format like `fieldName[op]=value` where `op` is one of: `eq` (equals), `ne` (not equals), `cn` (contains), `sw` (starts with), `ew` (ends with), `gt` (greater than), `gte` (greater than or equal), `lt` (less than), `lte` (less than or equal), `rgx` (regular expression).

info.name: Ignition Gateway REST access-control logging API

description.content:
The Ignition Gateway REST API (Ignition 8.3+) provides an OpenAPI-compliant HTTP interface to Gateway configuration resources including tags, projects, modules, device connections, historian data, user management (SCIM), alarm notification, OPC connections, and more. The specification is dynamically generated based on installed modules. Authentication uses API keys exchanged for time-limited tokens via the X-Ignition-API-Token header. Mutative requests are audit-logged. Supports Kubernetes and Helm-based cloud-native deployments.
